statement: The adaptive repair loop and repair-before-RL ordering proposed in the idea are already implemented and evaluated: an LLM-judged, history-aware repair pipeline audits failed one-hop validation cases, categorizes invalid/noisy triples versus missing knowledge, generates targeted repair examples, and RL initialized from repaired checkpoints yields larger and more stable gains than RL from unrepaired ones.

evidence.quote: Section 3.6 describes the LLM-judged and history-aware adaptive triple repair pipeline, which identifies unresolved 1-hop knowledge gaps after SFT and generates targeted repair examples.
